scientific_integrity: The known apex-plus-regular-base formula was previously published as a lower bound in 2016. The mathematical claim proved here is its unrestricted optimality up to the exact saturation threshold, together with complete equality cases. The result is subject to historical-priority uncertainty and has not undergone independent review.
scientific_limitations: Unit-radius Euclidean spherical caps only; dimensions n >= 2; heights 0 < h <= 2. Computer tests are finite supplements to an analytic proof. No claim of absolute novelty or independent mathematical certification.
title: Sharp maximum-simplex volumes and equality cases in Euclidean spherical caps
